main.description: A group role and its group-wide grants, keyed by role ID. Written by the group in the members space. Grants within a space live in that space's policy.

default.description: If true, granted to members admitted through requestJoin.

scopes.description: Group-wide OAuth scopes, one per item. For scopes not tied to one space, such as manage=create, rpc: scopes, and space:* grants.

assignable.description: Keys of roles this role may assign, or * for every role.
